review.words: Whether the series summing 1/(n!-1) over n at least 2 has an irrational value.

statement.text:
import Mathlib
import Nodes.«erdos-68--h2».Context

/-! Hole `h2` of a merged partial proof, as a node (D-12 #5, D-29).
Statement generated by the gate from the assembly; immutable (D-3). -/

theorem erdos_68__h2 : ∀ (N : ℕ),
  (2 : ℕ) ≤ N →
    ∃ (c : ℝ),
      (0 : ℝ) < c ∧
        c ≤ (2 : ℝ) / (↑N : ℝ) ∧
          (↑N.factorial : ℝ) * ∑' (n : ℕ), (1 : ℝ) / ((↑(n + (2 : ℕ)).factorial : ℝ) - (1 : ℝ)) =
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) N, (↑N.factorial : ℝ) / ((↑n.factorial : ℝ) - (1 : ℝ)) + c := by
  sorry
